sections.heading: SMART goals
sections.body: Set goals that are Specific, Measurable, Achievable, Relevant, and Time-bound. For example: 'Save ₱500,000 for emergency fund in 24 months' or 'Pay off credit card balance in 18 months.'

sections.heading: Inflation matters
sections.body: Prices rise over time (often 3–5% per year in the PH). When planning for a future amount (e.g., house down payment in 10 years), use inflation-adjusted targets: target today × (1 + inflation rate)^years. Our assessment tool does this for you.
